Question: A factory's items come from three machines A, B, and C, which produce 25%, 35%, and 40% of all items respectively. Their defect rates are 5%, 4%, and 2% respectively. An item is selected at random. Find the probability that it is defective. Report a reduced fraction.

raw_response:
Total defective probability using law of total probability:

P(D) = P(A)P(D|A) + P(B)P(D|B) + P(C)P(D|C)

= 0.25·0.05 + 0.35·0.04 + 0.40·0.02
= 0.0125 + 0.0140 + 0.0080
= 0.0345

Convert to fraction: 0.0345 = 345/10000 = 69/2000

Check reduction: 345 = 5·69 = 5·3·23; 10000 = 5·2000. So 69/2000. GCD(69,2000)=1.

Final answer: 69/2000
